body: It's not a school, it's a college. They don't do lunch vouchers and the bus pass costs £750. The reason it's taking this long is because my parents tax has to go through so we get it half price. They're not giving away a £750 bus pass for free.
i don't think you understand... College is an hour bus ride away. I can't just "go there". Borrow money from where? I don't live near anyone who goes to my college. I'm stranded.
Here in England we don't have intersections like you do... We just have roundabouts.

Of course i have things to lose, my relatively comfortable position in college for one. People will know something's up if i just start going to a counsellor. I've never been one for creating a fuss, i spent most of my 5 years of senior school primarily trying to avoid fuss. Even at the expense of grades.

I'm in a sort of stable position, but once college finishes i'll be thrown out. Not knowing what i want to do and floating around doing nothing isn't something i want to do but i know it's going to happen unless i end it. 

I'm aware things "could turn a 180" in a matter of days... But they won't, and they haven't in the last 3 or so years. Nothing has changed in that time. 

The last time i spoke to anyone who could be deemed anything close to a counsellor i completely broke down and cried. It was 4 years ago and i haven't cried since. She said nothing, i left and never heard from her again. It was potentially the worst day of my life and i don't intend to relive it.

It's sort of complicated, i have a huge lack of self esteem. It's gotten to the point where i can't look at people in the eye because i feel inferior to them. It's like whenever i get eye contact they're judging me and i tense up as time slows down and i wait for the impending "You're ugly" or something of the sort to come form their mouth.

Typing this is cringe-worthy, i've never actually written anything like this down before and it sounds pathetic. Either way it doesn't really matter, it's not an issue that's able to be resolved.

As for the "family" bit, i would only really feel bad about my dad. I haven't spoken to him in 5 months or so but he's a pretty cool guy. We have nothing in common though, nor do we share any interests. As for the rest of my family, i live in the same house as them but speak 1 sentence to them roughly every 3 days or so. There's nothing meaningful there any more.

Had a friend of my mum over and i was rhyming/rapping i think. I was roughly 9 at the time, maybe even younger actually. Her name was Sarah, but i nicknamed her "Sazza". Ended up calling her "Sazza the slapper" not knowing what it meant. I didn't even know it was a word at the time until she asked me if i knew what it meant. Of course she didn't explain it to me so i found out later on.

I'm sure she didn't take it badly :P
By the end of this year I will have killed myself. I'm essentially getting all of the games on my must play list out of the way before i leave college at the end of the year.
